external_references.observation: Official Seoul description separates signal, streetlight and combined S-Pole models and LED lighting. Used as functional integration reference, not placement/dimensions.
Official Seoul article describes red/green pedestrian information coordinated at crossings. Text reviewed; no claim to reconstruct the photographed location.

provenance.lamp: Authored dark slim tapered poles, short horizontal LED heads, base flange/service door; no imported photograph texture
provenance.paint: Source-display3.2m lane cadence,4m dashes/12m gaps; shared continuous double-yellow median on paired directions and outer-union edges. Original1.6m sedan centre retained. Boundaries clipped to owned direction; conflicting overlapping source lane tags are not a measured lane-count claim.
provenance.schedules: 46 second coordinated game cycle, protected29-43s pedestrian phase with final5s flashing; never a live Seoul signal plan
provenance.source: Existing OpenStreetMap-derived road/display triangles, existing traffic conflicts and all original entry candidates
provenance.surface_mask: Source walk render mesh only minus source drive outside solids/private. Original source files/nodes/colliders/public-walk permissions unchanged. Terrain projection is applied once to newly authored flat vertices after terrain.loaded.
provenance.terrain: After EXP21 terrain.loaded; exact triangle-split runtime projection once, .052m relative paint offset above base TIN, road display .035m
